question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to ~$13.0B ±$300M; consensus ~$13.06B. Over the last 8 quarters AMD beat its guidance midpoint every time, by 1.8%-7% (median ~4%): Q3'24 +1.8%, Q4'24 +2.1%, Q1'25 +4.8%, Q2'25 +3.9%, Q3'25 +6.3%, Q4'25 +7%, Q1'26 +4.6%, Q2'26 +3.0% (11.54B vs 11.2B mid). Applying that to 13.0B gives a median of ~13.45B. Downside drivers: management cites tight supply (wafers, packaging, substrates, HBM) and Helios shipments are minor in Q3. Escapes past 12.0B or 14.2B would need a miss below the guidance floor or a ~9% beat, so none priced. Market check: harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold; my searches found no Kalshi or bookmaker market either (did not search Kalshi directly).

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to about $13.0B ± $0.3B, and consensus is about $13.06-13.2B. In each of the last 8 quarters AMD beat its guidance midpoint, by +1.8% to +7.0% (+3% to +7% over the last six quarters). The most recent beat (Q2'26, +3.0%) was the smallest of the last six, and management says supply is tight, which caps upside. At a ~3.8% beat the median comes to ~$13.5B. Stress in AI financing mostly affects Q4 and later, because Q3 is already over, so it only adds a modest left tail. Leaving the $12.0-14.2B range would take a beat above 9% or a miss of more than 7% on a finished quarter, so I price neither escape. No human prediction market was found: the harness checked Polymarket and Manifold, and the runs found nothing on Kalshi or with bookmakers.
calls.reconciliation: The three dossiers agree on the facts: $13.0B ± $0.3B guidance, ~$13.06B consensus, a Q2'26 beat of 3.0%, no pre-announcement, and no market. The only factual difference is that Run 1 includes Q3'24 and Q4'24, whose smaller beats (~2%) pull the median down to $13.45B. Those guidance midpoints were recalled from memory and I cannot check them without web access, but the numbers look plausible and only lower the reference class slightly. Where to put the median ($13.45-13.55B) is a judgment call: the beats have shrunk recently and supply is constrained, while the ramp keeps growing. I'd bet on ~$13.5B. On escape mass, Run 2 put 2% above the upper bound. I dropped it because no recent beat comes close to 9% and the quarter is already complete. I retrieved nothing myself on this run.
